title: Great tour!
text: Our guide Celia was great. Provided great insight into the history of the Alhambra and kept our small group engaged throughout the tour! I would highly recommend to friends. Viator tours has not disappointed us!
author: Mark_W

title: TouringBee Granada.
text: Our first experience with TouringBee and it worked really well. Lots of clear information. Well presented. And easy to dip in and out. Would definitely use again
author: rosicampbell01
